description: This file is the entry point for a React web application. It imports React and ReactDOM, along with various CSS styles and the main App component. It sets up the root element in the DOM and renders the App component wrapped in React.StrictMode, serving as the main script that initializes the frontend application.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React application into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root element.
